query:
INSERT INTO campaign_queue (searchId, companyId, userId, companyName, jobType, status, createdAt)
SELECT c.searchId, c.id, 1, c.name, 'full', 'pending', NOW()
FROM companies c
WHERE c.searchId = 1500002
  AND c.enrichmentStatus != 'failed'
  AND (c.briefData IS NULL OR c.salesApproachData IS NULL)
  AND c.id NOT IN (
    SELECT cq.companyId FROM campaign_queue cq
    WHERE cq.searchId = 1500002 AND cq.status IN ('pending', 'running')
  );
